name: Tonic | 10mg Beverage | Fizz Grapefruit 1:1
description:
10mg THC : 10mg CBD

Enjoy the perfect balance of flavor and effects with Tonic Fizz 1:1 Grapefruit. Infused with 10mg of cannabis extract in an equal 1:1 ratio of CBD to THC, this sparkling beverage offers a harmonious and refreshing experience. The tangy and slightly sweet grapefruit flavor makes it ideal for relaxation, socializing, or finding focus. Treat yourself to this bubbly and uplifting drink for a balanced cannabis moment.
